reimbursement_policies.evidence: Facility-inclusive charges bundle routine room and board services, nursing, supplies, equipment, and many airway-support services into the facility payment. Tracheostomy care and ventilator/CPAP management are not separately reimbursed as routine components, except for one unit per day for facility-owned ventilator or CPAP management.

This policy is a preadmission payment-window rule for inpatient stays, not DRG case-management guidance. It bundles qualifying outpatient services into the inpatient stay, with an outside-window exception for donor post-kidney transplant complication services.

The policy is not a transplant case-management policy, but it does apply general inpatient preadmission payment-window bundling rules to these admissions. Applicable outpatient diagnostic and admission-related nondiagnostic services are bundled into the inpatient stay during the payment window, except that Medicare Advantage donor post-kidney transplant complications services are excluded from the payment window and may be separately reimbursed.

recommended_action.description:
Recommendation 1: Bundle outpatient preadmission services into the cesarean inpatient payment when billed by the admitting hospital, hospital-owned entity, or entity under hospital arrangements for the same inpatient admission, '3 days before admission,' or '1 day before admission'; require modifier 'PD' and apply the '3-day window'/'1-day window' for Medicaid and Medicare Advantage, while preserving exemptions for 'Critical Access Hospitals,' 'ambulance services,' 'maintenance renal dialysis,' 'hospice services,' and 'unrelated nondiagnostic services with 51.' Apply to CA. Exempt: Critical Access Hospitals, ambulance services, maintenance renal dialysis, hospice services, unrelated nondiagnostic services with 51. Peer: Elevance Health external and internal both require modifier PD and use 3-day/1-day preadmission bundling windows, with Critical Access Hospitals and ambulance services exempted..

Recommendation 2: For 'UB-04' Medicaid facility claims tied to cesarean admissions, bundle hospital-inclusive routine services on the 'same claim' or 'same facility claim' for revenue codes '250', '260-269', '270-279', '300-370', '309', and '361' when they are part of the 'same facility charge,' 'same room and board charge,' or 'same surgical room charge'; for ventilator/CPAP management, allow only '1 unit/day' on the 'same day,' and do not separately reimburse services furnished by 'routine nursing staff,' 'respiratory therapists,' 'technicians,' or 'perfusionists,' while preserving the 'Pre- and Post-Anesthesia Recovery Room' exemption. Apply to CA. Exempt: Pre- and Post-Anesthesia Recovery Room.
